setting: shared pooled-context subset of 100 HotpotQA validation questions; not official fullwiki
retrieval_unit: one preserved context paragraph per document
deduplication: Original preparation merged repeated title/sentence contexts; runtime additionally merges exact title/body duplicates and preserves aliases. Same body with different titles remains distinct.
scope: Complete existing 997-paragraph corpus, including distractors; no answer, question, qrels, or supporting-fact labels included.
local_locator_base: project root; source text is the text field in chunks.jsonl
